# Research references

Primary mechanical references:

1. Beretta APX A1 user manual — striker-fired trigger sequence, striker return spring, materials and chassis/frame description.
   https://www.beretta.com/content/dam/beretta-usa/user-manuals/APX_A1_Manual.pdf

2. RemArms / Remington Model 700 manual — bolt handle raise, rearward travel, forward travel and downward locking movement.
   https://www.remarms.com/sites/default/files/documents/700%20Manual%20RD7055%20Final%20F3509.pdf

3. O.F. Mossberg pump-action owner manual — top safety button and separate action-lock lever.
   https://resources.mossberg.com/hubfs/manuals/12173-Owners-Manual-Pumps-English.pdf

4. Heckler & Koch MP5 product documentation — closed-bolt, roller-delayed blowback architecture.
   https://www.heckler-koch.com/en/Products/Military%20and%20Law%20Enforcement/Submachine%20guns/MP5

5. U.S. Army FM 3-21.8, Appendix B — M72 nested launcher tubes and percussion-type firing mechanism.
   https://www.marines.mil/Portals/1/Publications/FM%203-21.8%20%20The%20Infantry%20Rifle%20Platoon%20and%20Squad_7.pdf

Acoustic synthesis reference:

6. Mitsuko Aramaki and Richard Kronland-Martinet, “Analysis-Synthesis of Impact Sounds by Real-Time Dynamic Filtering,” IEEE TASLP, 2006 — filtered-noise impact model and spectral damping.
   https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/iel5/10376/33593/01597271.pdf

The library does not embed or redistribute audio recordings from these sources. All preview audio is generated by the compiled C core from seeded noise.
